semantics.api_requests: Unique token_usage_record response IDs; event ordinals are not API requests.
semantics.exec_tool_calls: Top-level Codex exec tool calls; one call can contain zero, one, or several shell command executions.
semantics.command_execution_events: Raw started/completed event records; unique item counts are separate.
semantics.command_execution_items: Unique command_execution item IDs, not a count of shell subcommands inside a compound command.
semantics.os_process_count: OS shell process counts are not recorded in these logs.
semantics.file_change_items: Unique file_change item IDs; reported_changes sums changes-array lengths once per item.
semantics.skill_access: reader_commands counts executed reader commands found in command_execution items. successful_direct_reads requires one isolated reader command in its event item and exit code 0; batch commands are never treated as successful reads. Missing exit codes remain reader_exit_unavailable. Search/list operations, ambiguous references, and mentions are separate; rollout output text is not evidence of a read.
